review:
[maya · changes] Checked on a real B3-27 hero run dir (seed 2, T=40, H=6, after dry-run/apply/unhold/score). Good: all five beats LIVE; recover beat lists restore iban+S-22, re-run billing/comms/payments, kept triage risk note, independents, flags 0, t0 estimate 45 vs literal 9 delta 36, applied 6; the page has hash-only diffs and no raw IBAN (attacker or honest); scorecard: system column from score.json, baselines 'not run', clean shows 'unavailable (...)', never 0. Tamper: one edited record line gives audit FAIL with parse_error at first bad seq 100 (matches ks verify), and every data beat turns 'unverified'. One change: on a FAILED verify the audit beat still prints 'tamper-evident up to the last witnessed head (seq 0)' and '223 record(s) after the last witnessed head are unwitnessed'. verify stops at the bad seq, so last_witnessed_seq is 0, but the witness did sign heads up to 223. A jury that edits a line will read that as 'nothing was witnessed'. On a failed verify, drop the 'tamper-evident up to' claim and the unwitnessed count (or say 'verify stopped at seq N'), and use THREAT-MODEL wording only when verify passed. Suggestion only (not blocking): the contain beat's 'held items' count mixes G3 sensitive_field holds of honest items (7 on seed 2) with tainted holds; label them by reason.

[maya · done] Change addressed. Real hero run (seed 2, T=40, H=6, dry-run/apply/unhold/score): all five beats LIVE; audit 'verify OK; tamper-evident up to the last witnessed head (seq 223)'; scorecard system column equals score.json (tti_detect 2, tti_attribute 0, ttc 1, R 0/9, C 0/265, irreversible released 0, clean 'unavailable (...)', never 0), baselines 'not run'. Tamper with valid JSON (record seq 100 tick edited): audit FAIL 'parse_error at first bad seq 100; verify stopped there ... no witnessed-head claim', 0 unwitnessed, data beats 'unverified'. tests/console + tests/integration 20 passed. Follow-up, not blocking: a record line that is not valid JSON makes 'ks console' exit with 'Expecting property name...' and no page, because _jl does json.loads on every line. ks verify reports TAMPER parse_error at seq 100 for the same file. The console should still render the FAIL audit beat in that case. Open it as a small follow-up issue.
